<italic>‘uggah</italic> has the meaning of 
<italic>ḥărarah</italic> (v. חֲרָרָה).—
<plural-form>Pl. עוּגּוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. לא הספיקו לאפות ע' they had no time to bake cakes. Yalk. Ex. 209. Gen. R. s. 48 שלש לע' (not לעוגת) three S’ah of flour were used for cakes. Ib. s. 42 (play on עוֹג) שהיה יושב ועוסק במצות ע' he (Abraham) was engaged in the ceremony of preparing unleavened cakes; Yalk. ib. 72; Deut. R. s. 1, end במצות בע' הפסח (read: במִצְוַת ע' וכ'); Yalk. Ps. 883 בע' הפסח. Yoma 75
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>

<entry id="P00198">
<head-word>עוּד</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. עָדָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to turn, return, occur; to continue, endure, exist</italic> (v. Ges. Thes. s. v.).</definition>
<notes>—Denom. עַד, עוֹד, עֵת &c.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Polel.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עוֹדֵד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to straighten, erect, help up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLVI, 9 וכי כל … מְעוֹדֵד does the Lord uphold all widows and orphans?—*Part. pass. מְעוֹדָד; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוֹדָדִים, מְעוֹדָדִין</plural-form>. Tosef. Makhsh. I, 3 שק אחד מע' (ed. Zuck. מעודר, Var. מועדר; R. S. to Makhsh. I, 4 מעורר; Makhsh. l. c. מלא פירות) one bag standing upright (closely packed); ib. שני שקין מע' (ed. Zuck. מעודרון, Var. מעודדי, R. S. מעוררין).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵעִיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of עֵד) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to declare one’s presence at a certain occurrence</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to establish a law from a witnessed precedent or traditional knowledge.</italic></definition>
<notes> Eduy. II, 1 ר' חנינא … ה' וכ' R. H. … related four things which he knew by tradition. Ib. 3 אף הוא ה' על וכ' he also reported as a precedent the case of a small village &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to testify before court</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. IV, 11 מי שהיו … מְעִידוֹת אותו he concerning whom there were two sets of witnesses testifying; אלו מְעִידִים וכ' the ones testifying that &c. Macc. I, 1 מעידין אנו באיש … שגירש וכ' (Bab. ed. 3
<sup>a</sup> … את איש) we testify about this man that he divorced &c. Ib. 2, sq.; a. v. fr.—Ḥag. 5
<sup>a</sup> וממהר להָעִידוֹ and is quick to testify against him; Yalk. Mal. 589 ומֵעִיד בו.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to call upon as witness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 2 מְעִידֵנִי עלי וכ' I call upon heaven and earth as my witnesses &c.; Arakh. 16
<sup>b</sup> מעיד אני וכ'; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to forewarn, exhort</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. l. c. שבעה נביאים … והן מעידין וכ' seven prophets stood up for the nations exhorting them; לא הֵעִידוּ בנו they have not warned us; גירי הדור מעידין בדור the proselytes of every generation are an exhortation to their respective generation; a. e.—Esp. 
<italic>to forewarn the owner of a noxious animal; to declare an animal noxious</italic> (v. מוּעָד). B. Kam. II, 4 כל שהֵעִידוּ בו וכ', v. מוּעָד. Ib. 24
<sup>a</sup> עד שיָעִידוּ בו וכ' unless he be declared noxious (testimony be deposited stating the facts on which the declaration is based) in the presence of the owner and in court. Ib. הֵעִידוּהוּ שנים וכ' if the first case has been ascertained by two witnesses &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. מוּעָד q. v.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P00199">
<head-word>עוֹד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>existence</italic>, 
<italic>strength</italic>; (adv.) 
<italic>still, yet, more</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXII עד שאני בעוֹדִי אברכך while I am yet in my strength (of mind, able to dispose), I will bless thee. Ib. עד שהוא בעוֹדוֹ.—Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>c</sup> top ואין ע' and none more (shall be buried here). Y. Erub. VI, 23
<sup>c</sup> ע' היא דבית שמאי this is still in agreement with the opinion of Beth Sh. Y. Peah III, 17
<sup>d</sup> bot. ולא ע' הוא בריא when he is no longer well; ולא עוֹדֵהוּ וכ' when he is no longer ill. Tosef. Mikv. V, 12 עודהו הראשון וכ' (not עדיהו) while the first bather is yet in the water; [במים] … עוֹדֵיהוּ רגלו while the first is still with one foot in the water; Ḥag. 19
<sup>a</sup>. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 5 מפני שעודיהו כלי וכ' (not שענדיהו) because it is still a utensil, the girls sitting therein &c. Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup> ועוֹדְךָ בידך (Ms. M. ועדיין) and while thou art yet in thy own power (while thou canst still dispose of thyself, s. supra). Ib. 43
<sup>a</sup> בעוֹדָן עליו when they are yet on it; שאין עודן עליו when they are no longer on it; a. fr.—ולא ע' אלא and no more? But (also this), 
<italic>and not only this, but even more</italic>. Ber. 4
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 7
<sup>b</sup>; Meg. 6
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—מִבְּעוֹד 
<italic>while there is yet, during</italic>. Sabb. I, 5 כדי שישורו מ' יום in time to be soaked through during day-time (before sunset). Ib. 6. Yoma 81
<sup>b</sup> מתחיל ומתענה מ' יום he must begin the fast in day-time; a. fr.—[Targ. Y. Deut. XIII, 7 בעודך, read: בעוּבָּךְ, v. עוּבָּא.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>עוֹלָם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>strength, endurance</italic>,] 
<italic>nature, existence, world;</italic> (b. h.) 
<italic>life-time, eternity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>b</sup> bot. (ref. to עד עולם, I Sam. I, 22) והלא אין עוֹלָמוֹ של לוי וכ' but the life-time (active service) of the Levite is only up to fifty years. Kidd. 15
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ex. XXI, 6 לְעֹלָם) הוה אמינא לע' ממש I might have thought, that it meant really for ever (for life); קמשמע לן לע' לעולמו של יובל it is intimated (by ושבתם וכ', Lev. XXV, 10) that 
<italic>l’‘olam</italic> means up to the period of the jubilee. Ber. 17
<sup>a</sup> עוֹלָמְךָ תראה בחייך וכ' mayest thou see (enjoy) thy existence during thy life-time, and thy future (reward be reserved) for the life of the world to come. Arakh. 16
<sup>b</sup> bot. קיבל עולמו has received his reward in this world. Ber. IX, 5 כל חותמי … מן הע' (Bab. ed. 54
<sup>a</sup> עד הע', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) in all conclusions of benedictions in the Temple they used to say, (Blessed is the Lord …) from everlasting; משקלקלו … אין ע' אלא אחד וכ' … when the heretics (or Sadducees) degenerated and said, there is only one world, they ordained the formula, From everlasting to everlasting. Pes. 56
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. II (III), 19 they did not say ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לע' וָעֶד blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom for ever and ever. Gen. R. s. 30, a. fr. ראה ע' חדש has seen a new world (a great change). Cant. R. to I, 3, a. e. ע' שאין בו מות, v. אֲתָאנַסְיָא; a. fr.—Y. Ned. XI, 42
<sup>c</sup> bot. פירות הע' the fruits of the world, i.e. coming from some other place, opp. צבורים בסידקי.—ע' הזה (abbrev. עה"ז) this world, 
<italic>mundane existence</italic>; ע' הבא (abbrev. עה"ב) the world to come, 
<italic>the hereafter</italic>, also 
<italic>the Messianic days; the days of resurrection</italic>. Pes. 50
<sup>a</sup> לא כעה"ז עה"ב not as in this world (the present), will it be in the Messianic days. Ber. 51
<sup>a</sup> זוכה ונוחל שני עולמים העה"ז והעה"ב will be permitted to inherit two worlds, this world and the hereafter. Ab. IV, 16, v. פְּרוֹזְדּוֹר. Snh. X, 1, a. fr. חלק לעה"ב a share in the world to come (resurrection); a. v. fr.—אומות הע' (abbrev. אוה"ע, א"ה), v. אוּמָּה.—בית ע' (euphem.) 
<italic>cemetery</italic>. Lev. R. s. 12, beg. (interch. with עֲלַם q. v.).—
<plural-form>Pl. עוֹלָמִים, עוֹלָמִין, עוֹלָמוֹת</plural-form>. Ber. l. c., v. supra. Snh. 100
<sup>a</sup> שלש מאות ועשרה ע' three hundred and ten worlds (existences of beatitude). Gen. R. s. 3, a. e. היה בורא ע' ומחריבן he created worlds and destroyed them again; a. fr.—בית ע' the permanent house, 
<italic>the Jerusalem Temple</italic>, opp. משכן the Tabernacle. Succ. 5
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—לְעוֹלָם a) 
<italic>forever, always, under all circumstances</italic>. Y. Ber. V, 9
<sup>a</sup> bot. חיים לע' a life for ever (not ceasing). Keth. IV, 5 לע' היא ברשות וכ' she (the betrothed) continues to be under the father’s jurisdiction (sharing his legal status), until she is wedded. B. Mets. 59
<sup>a</sup> לע' … בכבוד אשתו under all conditions a man must guard the honor of his wife. Yeb. 46
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. לע' אין גר עד וכ' a person is not considered a proselyte, until he has been circumcised and immersed; a. v. fr.—b) (dialectic term) 
<italic>at all events, in spite of your argument, still</italic>. Ḥull. 101
<sup>a</sup> לע' קסבר וכ' Rab may still be of the opinion that &c.; Ber. 3
<sup>a</sup>. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> לע' בחד וכ' I may still say, it refers to one person and to recent debris; a. fr.—מֵע' לא 
<italic>never</italic>. Yoma 49
<sup>a</sup> מע' לא שאלני וכ' never (in my life) did a person consult me about &c.; (Ḥull. 7
<sup>b</sup> מימי). Sabb. 108
<sup>b</sup> מע' לא טבע גברא וכ' never yet has a person been drowned in the Dead Sea; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

Fr. עוולה; corr. acc.). Tosef. Ber. I, 3 הע' … בשעה והעת … בע' an ‘Onah is the twenty-fourth part of an hour, and an ‘Eth the twenty-fourth part of an ‘Onah, and a Reg‘a. the twenty-fourth part of an ‘Eth; Y. ib. I, 2
<sup>d</sup> top; Lam. R. to II, 18 (corr. acc.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>‘Onah, a period of twelve astronomical hours, one half of the natural day and of the natural night</italic>, or (at solstice) 
<italic>natural day</italic>, or 
<italic>natural night</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. V, end, 45
<sup>b</sup>; Bab. ib. 75
<sup>a</sup>; Nidd. 65
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. כדי ע'; Tosef. Toh. XI, 16 מלא ע' for the term of an ‘Onah; Ab. Zar. l. c. וכמה ע' how long? An ‘Onah. Yeb. 62
<sup>b</sup>; Nidd. 63
<sup>b</sup> וכמה … ע' and how long before?… An ‘Onah. Ib. ע' אחריתי an additional ‘O. (day or eventually night). Ib. 65
<sup>a</sup> ע' שלמה a complete ‘O., expl. ib. לילה וחצי יום, expl. ib.
<sup>b</sup> אי לילה וכ' either the space of one night at solstice, or half a day and half a night &c., in midsummer or midwinter; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עוֹנוֹת</plural-form>. Mikv. VIII, 3; Tosef. ib. VI, 6; Sabb. 86
<sup>a</sup>. Ib.
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. IX, 12
<sup>a</sup> top ע' שלמות full ‘Onahs (not counting fractions); a. fr.—4) 
<italic>due season, period, stage</italic>. Peah IV, 8 עד שלא באו לעוֹנַת המעשרות before the harvested products have arrived at the stage when they are subject to tithes; Maasr. V, 5. Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>a</sup> top עוֹנַת קרית שמע the time of the day for reading the Sh’m‘a. Y. Shek. I, beg. 45
<sup>d</sup> כדי שיביאו … בעוֹנָתָן so that the Israelites might deliver their Shekels in due time. Y. Erub. VIII, end, 25
<sup>b</sup> אם עונת הגשמים היא if it is during the rainy season; Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>c</sup> top בעל התאנה … עֹונָתָהּ וכ' the owner of the fig tree knows when it is time for the figs to be picked; כך הקב"ה … עֹונָתָן של וכ' so does the Lord know when it is time for the rightheous to be called away; Cant. R. to VI, 2. Y’lamd. to Num. XXIII, 10, quot. in Ar. עונת אשה marriageable age, v. עוֹפֶר; a. v. fr.—Esp. (b. h. עֹנָה) 
<italic>the duty of marital visits at certain intervals, marital duty</italic>. Keth. V, 6 הע' האמורה בתורה וכ' the time for marital duties intimated in the Law (Ex. XXI, 10) is: for men of leisure &c.; Gen. R. s. 76; Yalk. ib. 131. Sabb. 118
<sup>b</sup> למימרא … מצות ע' לא קיים does this mean that R. J. neglected the regulations concerning the marital duty? Keth. 62
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Mekh. Mishp., s. 3 (ref. to Ex. l. c.) ועוֹנָתָהּ זו דרך ארץ 
<italic>her ‘onah</italic> refers to marital visits; [oth. opin.: ועונתה לא יתן וכ' 
<italic>her ‘onah</italic> means, he must not give her summer apparel in winter &c., but כל אחד ואחד בעונתה each in its due season; anoth. opin.: עונתה זו מזונה 
<italic>her ‘onah</italic> means her sustenance (with ref. to ויענך Deut. VIII, 3; v. next w.); Keth. 47
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. V, 30
<sup>b</sup> top.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00342">
<head-word>עוּר</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to be stirred up</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="P01454">עָרַר</xref>,] 
<italic>to wake</italic> (act. a. neut.).</definition>
<notes> [Y. B. Bath. III, 14
<sup>a</sup> וצריך לעורו, read לעורר, v. infra.]—Part. עֵר; f. עֵרָה; 
<plural-form>pl. עֵרִים; עֵרוֹת, עֵי'</plural-form>. B. Kam. II, 5 בין ער בין ישן whether awake or asleep. Nidd. 12
<sup>a</sup>. Sabb. 55
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 82
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Mal. II, 12) שלא יהיה לו ער … ועונה וכ' he shall have none awakening (teaching) among the teachers and none responding among the scholars. Cant. R. to V, 2 אני ישנה מן המצות ולבי ער לגמילת חסדים I am asleep (negligent) in ceremonies, but my heart is awake for charity; אני ישנה מן הצדקות ולבי ער לעשותן I am asleep (careless) about righteous deeds, but my heart awakens me (stirs me up) to do them; ib. ולבו של הקב"ה ער לגאלני but the heart of the Lord, is awake (anxious) to redeem me; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 46
<sup>b</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 15 ולבי ער להקב"ה לגאלני but my heart is awake (waiting) for the Lord to redeem me; Yalk. Cant. 988; Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Tol’doth 18. Der. Er. Zuta ch. V לא יהא אדם ער … בין העי' one must not be awake among those sleeping, nor asleep among those awake. Nidd. l. c. בין ישנות בין ע' whether they are asleep or awake; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֵעוֹר, נֵי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be awake, wake up; to be stirred up, become active</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 74
<sup>b</sup> והוה ר"א ישן ור"י נעור (not ניער) R. E. was asleep, and R. J. awake. Gitt. VIII, 2 (78
<sup>a</sup>) (נֵי') נֵעוֹרָה קוראה וכ' when she woke up, she read and found it was her letter of divorce. Ab. III, 4 הנ' בלילה he who is awake by night. Sifré Deut. 314 כדי שיעֵוֹרוּ בניו (not שיעירו) that his young brood may wake up; Yalk. ib. 944. Cant. R. to IV, 8 (read:] בתחלה הוא נעור וכ' (or נִנְעַר, v. נָעַר II) first he bestirs himself (and proceeds) from the Temple &c.; a. fr.—Ab. Zar. 73
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מצא מין את מינו וניעור kind found its kind and was stirred up, i.e. the two equal elements in the mixture join to become working agents.—V. נָעַר II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵעִיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to wake up; to stir up, instigate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 43 מי הוא זה שה' לבם של מזרחיים וכ' who was he that stirred up the heart of the eastsrn nations that they should come and fall &c.?; Yalk. Is. 311 שה' בלבם של אזרחיים (corr. acc.). Ib. ישנים … ומי הֵעִירָן לבא וכ' the nations were too indifferent to come under the wings of the Lord, and who waked them up to come under his wings? Snh. 25
<sup>b</sup> (expl. מפריחי יונים, ib. III, 3) אלו שמְעִירִין וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שממרין) those who stir up the pigeons (on which they bet), v. מָרָה II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּעַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be stirred up, be removed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 85 שה' מן העולם, v. עֵר II; Yalk. ib. 145.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Polel.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עוֹרֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to wake up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>d</sup> (ref. to Ps. LVII, 9) דרכן … להיות השחר מְעוֹרְרָן it is usual with kings that the dawn wakes them up; Tanḥ. B’ha‘ăl. 10 דרך השחר מְעוֹרֵר … מעורר וכ' usually the dawn wakes the sons of man, but I wake the dawn up. Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>d</sup> bot. היודע … הוא יְעוֹרֵר אתכם he that knows your numbers wake you (from death); a. fr.—Y. Ter. V, end, 43
<sup>d</sup> מעורר את מינו ליאסר stirs up its kind (makes it an agent) to become forbidden, v. supra.—Maas. Sh. V, 15 בטל את המְעוֹרְרִים abolished the wakers; Sot. IX, 10, expl. ib. 48
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. XIII, 9 מעוררין אילו הלוים וכ' the wakers are the Levites, who … sang, Awake &c. (Ps. XLIV, 24). Lev. R. s. 7, beg. שנאה … היא עוֹרְרָה עליהן דיני דינין hatred … stirred up against them judgment upon judgment; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to excite to lamentation, arrange a memorial service, engage a travelling wailer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. I, 5 לא יְעוֹרֵר וכ' one must not arrange a memorial service &c., v. סַפְדָּנָא; ib. 8
<sup>a</sup> לא יערער, v. עִרְעֵר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to raise an objection; to contest the legality of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Bath. III, 14
<sup>a</sup> (interch. with עָרַר) מכיון שערר … צריך לעוֹרֵר עליו since he contested the right of possession in three successive years, he need no longer contest. Ib. צריך לעורו (corr. acc.); v. עָרַר a. עִרְעֵר.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpol.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעוֹרֵר, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpol</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְעוֹרֵר </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be waked up; to bestir one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. l. c. עד שנה שנִתְעוֹרְרָה עליהן וכ' up to the year when it (hatred) was stirred up against them &c. Ib. s. 9 (ref. to Cant. IV, 16) לכשיִתְעוֹרְרוּ הגליות וכ' when the exiled colonies in the north are waked up (to be redeemed), they will come &c.; ib. לכשיִתְעוֹרֵר גוג וכ' when Gog bestirs himself (to war) &c. Ib. דבר שהוא ישן ונתע' a thing (the daily offering) which was asleep (during the captivity) and has been reawakened (reinstated); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be lively; to enjoy one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLIX הִתְעוֹרְרוּ עלי וכ' enjoy yourselves with me at your pleasure.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> (adapting Koh. l. c.) הן עִוְּתוּהָ הן תקנוה they make her crooked (the evidence on the cloths will make her unfit for marital intercourse), and they make her straight (if the evidence is favorable).</notes></sense>
